stem_md: $f(x,y)=\begin{cases}\frac{\sqrt{|xy|}}{x^2+y^2}\sin(x^2+y^2),&x^2+y^2\ne0\\0,&x^2+y^2=0\end{cases}$，命题正确的有(\quad)个：①$f_x'(0,0)=0$；②$f_y'(0,0)=0$；③$f$ 在原点可微。
analysis_md:
$$f_x'(0,0)=\lim_{\Delta x\to0}\frac{f(0+\Delta x,0)-f(0,0)}{\Delta x}=0，\quad f_y'(0,0)=\lim_{\Delta y\to0}\frac{f(0,0+\Delta y)-f(0,0)}{\Delta y}=0$$
记 $\alpha=\Delta z-f_x'(0,0)\Delta x-f_y'(0,0)\Delta y=f(x,y)=\frac{\sqrt{|\Delta x\Delta y|}}{(\Delta x)^2+(\Delta y)^2}\sin((\Delta x)^2+(\Delta y)^2)$，
有 $$\lim_{\substack{\rho\to0\\\Delta x=\Delta y}}\frac{\alpha}{\rho}=\lim_{\Delta x\to0}\frac{\sqrt{(\Delta x)^2}\sin 2(\Delta x)^2}{\sqrt{2(\Delta x)^2}\,2(\Delta x)^2}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\ne0，$$因此 $f(x,y)$ 在 $(0,0)$ 处不可微。
